# Preface and schedule {.unnumbered}

This [Quarto](https://quarto.org) book contains the course materials and information for [Markup Languages and Reproducible Programming in Statistics](https://osiris-student.uu.nl/#/onderwijscatalogus/extern/cursus?cursuscode=202000010&taal=en&collegejaar=huidig). The numbered sections in this book correspond to the weeks, where every week is represented by a single chapter.

| Week                  | Focus                                       |
|-----------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| @sec-wk1 | Introduction to Markup Languages; and LaTeX |
| @sec-wk2 | Markdown in (most) Flavors                  |
| @sec-wk3 | Version Control and Development Flow        |
| @sec-wk4 | Reproducible Research Repositories          |
| @sec-wk5 | Creating and Publishing a Developer Portfolio                         |
| @sec-wk6 | Packages, Code Robustness and Unit Testing  |
